tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows sink-gradient dependence and concavity, consistent with multiple archived mechanisms. The open-branch probe is the least costly available targeted measurement for resolving this genuine model ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon with a square-root or linear-leak branch
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot rows do not reliably distinguish the branch forms or establish extrapolation behavior.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit cooperative Hill inhibition or barrier-modulated siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: These are plausible competing gradient-dependent mechanisms; the discriminating probe can help separate them from the inland-hub model.
The pilot does not yet establish a coupled memory mechanism, and this probe costs more.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
